event.title: Fairbanks Caregiver Support Group
event.description:
Caregiving can be deeply meaningful and, at times, incredibly hard. It is normal to feel both fulfilled and overwhelmed. You may sometimes feel like no one truly understands what you are going through, but you are not alone. We are here to listen, and support is available.

Caregiver Support Groups connect people with shared experiences in a welcoming space to offer understanding, encouragement, and practical insight. Participants can share what has helped them, learn from others, and access information about helpful local resources.

This free, in person Caregiver Support Group meets on the second Saturday of each month at the Noel Wien Library in Fairbanks. You are welcome to attend once or return as often as you find helpful.

event.title: Art Links – Fairbanks (in-person)
event.description:
Come and share the joy of Art Links with us in Fairbanks! Art Links is a social support program that promotes engagement for individuals diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias or seniors at risk of isolation and depression. By using a variety of creative art ideas, we promote self-expression as well as socialization and meaningful connections. Participants enjoy:

  • A variety of artistic mediums
  • Music and movement
  • Memory-rich conversations
  • Facilitated by ARA staff and local artists.

Free to attend! No registration required. Share with friends and family. With questions, contact Jennifer Willeford at JWilleford@alzalaska.org or 907-621-6071.

Caregiving can be deeply meaningful and, at times, incredibly hard. It is normal to feel both fulfilled and overwhelmed. You may sometimes feel like no one truly understands what you are going through, but you are not alone. We are here to listen, and support is available.

Caregiver Support Groups connect people with shared experiences in a welcoming space to offer understanding, encouragement, and practical insight. Participants can share what has helped them, learn from others, and access information about helpful local resources.

This free, in person Caregiver Support Group meets on the second Saturday of each month at the Noel Wien Library in Fairbanks. You are welcome to attend once or return as often as you find helpful.

event.title: Art Links – Fairbanks (in-person)
event.description:
Come and share the joy of Art Links with us in Fairbanks! Art Links is a social support program that promotes engagement for individuals diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias or seniors at risk of isolation and depression. By using a variety of creative art ideas, we promote self-expression as well as socialization and meaningful connections. Participants enjoy:

  • A variety of artistic mediums
  • Music and movement
  • Memory-rich conversations
  • Facilitated by ARA staff and local artists.

Free to attend! No registration required. Share with friends and family. With questions, contact Jennifer Willeford at JWilleford@alzalaska.org or 907-621-6071.
